page.overview:
What is G-2?

G-2 is a Marine Base in the Grand Line currently under the command of Vice Admiral Comil. It is located north-east of Lulusia Kingdom.

The G-2 base currently has at least eight officers with a rank higher than captain. Those include Vice Admiral Comil and an officer with the rank of commander. In the past, Rear Admiral Kadar would have been one of the officers of G-2. However, he is not present at the current meetings.

Other than the soldiers and officers, Kyuji and Koda also work there as part of the kitchen staff.
